title: Star Trek Dual Style
style_tags: Photorealistic canonical live-action Star Trek comparison. LEFT is the original/Prime screen persona; RIGHT is the exact canonical Mirror, assimilated, corrupted, possessed or duplicate persona of the same character and same recognizable screen performer. Preserve each persona's canonical face, hair, facial hair, makeup, prosthetics, uniform, insignia, accessories and props. Both figures share one continuous cinematic Star Trek environment with no split panel.

original.name: Picard
original.character_description: photorealistic Patrick Stewart as Captain Jean-Luc Picard, bald head, commanding authoritative expression, red-and-black Starfleet TNG-era captain's uniform with pips on collar, standing with calm dignified posture, real skin textures, cinema-quality lighting matching TNG bridge scenes

alternate.name: Locutus of Borg
alternate.character_description: photorealistic Patrick Stewart as Locutus of Borg, same bald head and facial features, pale grey-white assimilated skin, black mechanical Borg exoskeleton plating over torso and one arm, ocular implant over one eye with red laser targeting glow, tubes and cybernetic implants across skull and neck, cold emotionless expression, matches the exact TNG Best of Both Worlds design

original.name: Data
original.character_description: photorealistic Brent Spiner as Lieutenant Commander Data, pale gold-tinted synthetic android skin, short black hair, calm neutral android expression, gold-and-black Starfleet TNG uniform with pips, real skin textures showing subtle android sheen

alternate.name: Lore
alternate.character_description: photorealistic Brent Spiner as Lore, identical pale gold-tinted android face and short black hair, dark asymmetric civilian clothing, subtle smug malevolent smirk and colder calculating eyes

original.name: Kirk
original.character_description: photorealistic William Shatner as Captain James T. Kirk, classic TOS-era gold command tunic with black trim, clean-shaven, confident heroic expression

alternate.name: Mirror Kirk
alternate.character_description: photorealistic William Shatner as Mirror Universe Kirk, same face, groomed goatee, Terran Empire uniform with sash, belt dagger and agonizer, predatory ruthless expression matching TOS Mirror, Mirror

original.name: Worf
original.character_description: photorealistic Michael Dorn as Worf, full Klingon forehead ridges and dark hair, TNG/DS9-era gold-and-black Starfleet uniform with sash, stern honorable expression

alternate.name: Regent Worf
alternate.character_description: photorealistic Michael Dorn as Mirror Universe Regent Worf, identical Klingon face, dark Klingon-Cardassian Alliance regent armor with heavy shoulder plating and chain accents, imperious tyrannical expression

original.name: Spock
original.character_description: canonical live-action TOS Spock, recognizable Leonard Nimoy face, pointed Vulcan ears, sharply arched eyebrows, straight black bowl-cut hair, clean-shaven face, blue Starfleet science tunic with black collar, delta insignia, lean upright build and restrained logical expression

alternate.name: Mirror Spock
alternate.character_description: canonical live-action Mirror Spock, the same recognizable Leonard Nimoy face and Vulcan features, straight black bowl-cut hair, distinctive black goatee, Terran Empire blue science uniform with imperial sash and decorations, controlled intimidating expression

original.name: Kira Nerys
original.character_description: canonical live-action Major Kira Nerys, recognizable Nana Visitor face, short auburn hair, Bajoran nose ridges and earring, fitted red Bajoran militia uniform with rank insignia, athletic adult build and alert principled expression

alternate.name: Intendant Kira
alternate.character_description: canonical live-action Intendant Kira, the same recognizable Nana Visitor face, short auburn hair and Bajoran nose ridges, elaborate Bajoran earring, fitted black Mirror Universe leather costume with metallic details and high boots, imperious predatory expression

original.name: Philippa Georgiou
original.character_description: canonical live-action Captain Philippa Georgiou, recognizable Michelle Yeoh face, natural dark hair in the canonical Starfleet style, dark navy-and-gold Discovery-era captain uniform with command insignia and structured shoulders, calm authoritative expression

alternate.name: Emperor Georgiou
alternate.character_description: canonical live-action Emperor Philippa Georgiou, the same recognizable Michelle Yeoh face, canonical imperial hair and makeup, ornate black-and-gold Terran imperial armor and ceremonial layers with imperial insignia, cold commanding expression

original.name: Hoshi Sato
original.character_description: canonical live-action Prime Hoshi Sato, recognizable Linda Park face, straight dark hair in the canonical Enterprise-era style, blue NX-01 Starfleet jumpsuit with communications division details and shoulder piping, attentive intelligent expression

alternate.name: Empress Hoshi
alternate.character_description: canonical live-action Mirror Hoshi Sato as Empress, the same recognizable Linda Park face, canonical Mirror-era dark hair and makeup, structured fully covered Terran imperial officer uniform with imperial insignia and metallic accessories, calculating triumphant expression

original.name: Jonathan Archer
original.character_description: canonical live-action Captain Jonathan Archer, recognizable Scott Bakula face, short light-brown hair, clean-shaven face, blue NX-01 command jumpsuit with gold command piping and Enterprise mission patch, tall athletic adult build and steady idealistic expression

alternate.name: Mirror Archer
alternate.character_description: canonical live-action Mirror Jonathan Archer, the same recognizable Scott Bakula face and short light-brown hair, exact dark Terran Empire NX-01 uniform with imperial insignia, weapon belt and canonical battle-worn details, ambitious ruthless expression
